subject: Logic
title: Tragedy of the Commons
description: A micro-lesson that makes Tragedy of the Commons usable.

hook.text: Each farmer adds one more sheep to shared land. Rational for each, devastating for all—the pasture collapses.

buildup.text: The tragedy of the commons: individuals acting in self-interest deplete a shared resource.

discovery.text: Garrett Hardin described it in 1968: oceans, air, groundwater—all shared, all vulnerable to overuse.

twist.text: Elinor Ostrom won a Nobel proving communities can manage commons without privatization—through local rules.

climax.text: The tragedy isn't inevitable. Trust, communication, and enforceable agreements can sustain shared resources.

quiz.question: What causes the tragedy of the commons?
options: Individuals depleting a shared resource through self-interest
Lack of resources to begin with
